pages.text: Press $(k:hominin_evolution.social) near your band. It asks what you want to talk about first, then what to say - and only offers what fits the moment.$(br2)Right-click one of them beforehand to speak to that one alone. With another band near too, click $(l)Talk to your band$() at the top to talk to them instead.

$(l)Danger$()$(li)I'm hurt (when you are)$(li)Let's hunt together / Don't$(li)Let's climb a tree$(li)Keep watch with me tonight (bond 4+)$(br2)$(l)Social$()$(li)Groom them, Get these off me$(li)Let's play$(li)Info, Tribe stats$(li)Be my mate, Let's have a child$(li)Let me live as you for a while (bond 3+)$(li)Let's stick together today, to another band$(br2)$(l)Culture$() - your people's ways (erectus on)

$(l)Grooming$() is the oldest thing a primate does for another. Stand beside one for five seconds and they warm to you.$(br2)A member fond enough of you looks after you unasked: food when you are going hungry, a better weapon than the one you carry, a hammerstone when you have none.

They do a great deal without being asked. They forage, pull branches, make their own nests, carry nine things and drop the worst for something better, climb when frightened, and go off exploring and come back with what they found.$(br2)From habilis they have tastes of their own, break rocks on their own account, and will tell you what they want.

Feed one its favourite food and it remembers. Hand it what it asked for and it remembers that too.$(br2)Hit one while sneaking and it is wrestling, not fighting - and that is how both of you learn to fight.
$(l)Tribe stats$(), asked of the whole band: cohesion, who is mated to whom, who is closest to whom, how each of them feels about you, who is pregnant, and what each one wants.

$(l)Living as another.$() Someone of your band close to you - bond 3 and up - will let you live as them for a while. You open your eyes where they stood, as hurt and as hungry as they were, holding in mind what they held; the one you were carries on where you stood. What you carry stays with you.
